notes.title: Revamped mouse emulator
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340728/c39beb162229a9891266a8b47cffcf5ccb804d3a.png"][/img]With version 0.959, the interface for mouse emulator has been redone. It now acts as a game launcher with 33 lightgun playable games available by default. You can now launch games with a single click, and use or modify preset configurations with each game. You can also add custom games and utilities in a similar way.[/p]
